title: Horned Figure with Scroll
description: A black horned figure with pink drips on its face sits on swirling green cloth against a black background. The figure holds an open green scroll with paint writing while three glowing orbs float nearby showing silhouettes of people and night scenes with a moon.
prompt: A black horned figure with pink drips down its face sits on swirling green cloth. The figure holds a large open green scroll covered in painted writing. Three glowing orbs float nearby showing silhouettes of two people under a moon one with pink border. Blue swirling patterns with yellow flowers and leaves fill the top against a black background with more yellow petals falling.
